# KHAN Solutions
Veterinary practice management platform for multi-branch clinics. Inventory, clinical records, cash register, real-time analytics.

## Product
VETEK - All-in-one veterinary practice management software.
Multi-branch inventory tracking, SOAP clinical records, point-of-sale with automatic inventory sync, real-time analytics dashboard, role-based access control, three-language support (English, Spanish, Portuguese).
